refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Calculates the two-dimensional discrete Fourier transform of A using a Fast Fourier Transform algorithm. It performs two-dimentional FFT on the matrix A. You can use the variables m and n to specify the number of rows and columns of A that you want to use. If either of these variables is larger than the size of A, then A will be resized, and zeros will be added as padding.
